unreported_quarters.2021Q1: Ownership change Viela Bio to Horizon; no full-quarter figure is published. Horizon acquired Viela Bio on March 15, 2021; Viela published no first-quarter 2021 results, and Horizon's first-quarter 2021 release prints UPLIZNA 1.8 covering only March 15-31 (footnote 'UPLIZNA was acquired on March 15, 2021').
unreported_quarters.2023Q3: Ownership change Horizon to Amgen; no figure for the quarter is published. Amgen acquired Horizon on October 6, 2023; Horizon's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2023 (15-12G filed 2023-10-16), and Amgen reports Uplizna only from the acquisition date.
